subject: ENGLISH
title: Common or Proper? · M01 D06
introduction: Maxine is going to Cebu City! Sort general names from special names that start with a big letter.

vocabulary.definition: A word that names a person, place, or thing.
An animal is a living thing, like a dog, and its name can be a common noun or a proper noun.
A name for any person, place, or thing.

activities.instruction: Watch how common nouns and proper nouns are different!
activities.content: A common noun names a general person, place, animal, or thing. A proper noun names a specific one and begins with a capital letter.

feedback.correct: Nice work. Continue to the next step.

items.prompt: Which word is a proper noun?
items.explanation: Cebu City names one special city, so it is a proper noun with capital letters. City and island are general names for any place.

items.prompt: Which pair shows the proper noun for the common noun "city"?
items.explanation: Cebu City is the special name for the city, with a capital C. Pasig River is a river, not a city, and lowercase letters make a proper noun wrong.

items.prompt: Which word is written the WRONG way?
items.explanation: Maxine is a special name, so it must start with a capital letter: Maxine. Cebu City and Palawan are already written correctly.
Palawan names one special island, so it is a proper noun with a capital P. Island and teacher are general names for any place or person.
